messages:
Ava (CS Ops): hey team — quick sync on CRM hygiene + health scoring. noticed a bunch of accounts with stale owners and weird health tags. can we run a quick spike to 1) identify data gaps, 2) fix owner mapping, 3) wire an automated playbook when health < 40%?
Diego (CS): +1. where are you seeing the stale owners? list view in HubSpot?
Ava (CS Ops): yup HubSpot list + a dump from Snowflake. example rows: `account_id, owner, last_activity, renewal_date, usage_minutes, nps_score` — a lot of owners = null or `@contractor` placeholders.
Lena (Onboarding): onboarding status often lives in `cs_onboarding.status` (values: invited, in_progress, live). we should join that to health score so we don't trigger renewal outreach on accounts still onboarding.
Sam (Sales): if we auto-trigger a playbook on health <40 it needs a guard: if renewal_date > 90 days out, don't kick sales alerts. we spam them otherwise. :grimacing:
Noah (CSE): I can pull a Snowflake view with the fields Ava mentioned. propose this query for the spike:
```
SELECT a.account_id, a.name, a.owner, a.renewal_date, a.last_activity, m.usage_minutes, o.status AS onboarding_status, f.nps_score
FROM raw.accounts a
LEFT JOIN metrics.monthly_usage m USING(account_id)
LEFT JOIN cs.onboarding o USING(account_id)
LEFT JOIN feedback.nps f USING(account_id)
WHERE a.updated_at > dateadd(month, -6, current_date())
```
Ava (CS Ops): perfect. after the view we should compute a simple composite health score: 40% activity (last_activity, usage trend), 30% support signals (open_tickets, sev), 20% product metrics (weekly active users), 10% sentiment (nps/comments). keep it simple for the spike.
Diego (CS): can you share the exact HubSpot filter to find stale owners? i'll run a list export.
Ava (CS Ops): HubSpot contact list filter: `owner IS UNKNOWN OR owner IN ('contractor@redwood','placeholder')` and company property `last_activity_date < {{today}} - 180`
Lena (Onboarding): small ask — mark any account with onboarding_status != live as `health_override = 'onboarding'` so playbook doesn't trigger.
Noah (CSE): noted. I'll add `CASE WHEN o.status != 'live' THEN 'onboarding' END` in the view.
Sam (Sales): automation question — do we want playbook to run from HubSpot workflows or our internal Ops Playbooks? if internal we can page less.
Ava (CS Ops): prefer internal playbooks (more control + auditing). plan: when health_score < 40 AND health_override IS NULL AND renewal_date < dateadd(day, 180, today) -> create task for CSM, create Slack thread in #customer-success with summary, and set follow-up due in 3 days.
Diego (CS): can we add a two-step escalation? first task to CSM, if not claimed in 48h escalate to manager.
Ava (CS Ops): yes. that'll be part of automation config.
ops-bot: created ticket CSMOPS-482 for "CRM hygiene + healthscore spike" assigned to Ava (CS Ops)
Noah (CSE): timeline: i'll deliver Snowflake view + sample health_score calculation by EOD tomorrow. who will own HubSpot list export?
Diego (CS): i'll take the export and run dedupe/owner remap script. small note: owner remap needs mapping table (email -> CS owner). i have one but it's stale, i'll refresh it.
Lena (Onboarding): i'll provide the mapping for onboarding_status properties and a list of accounts mid-onboarding to exclude.
Sam (Sales): i'll add the renewal_date guard and confirm cadence for sales alerts.
Ava (CS Ops): next steps: 1) Noah - view + health calculation (EOD tomorrow) 2) Diego - HubSpot export + owner remap (48h) 3) Lena - onboarding exclusions (tomorrow) 4) Sam - confirm renewal guard and escalation policy (48h) 5) Ava - wire initial Playbook YAML and test in sandbox (after data ready).
Diego (CS): thumbs up. any objections to a soft-run (generate actions but don't notify) first?
Ava (CS Ops): yes soft-run first, then live after we validate ~100 sample accounts. :white_check_mark:
Noah (CSE): will include a sample CSV of the 100 accounts and the computed health_score so we can eyeball edge cases.
Lena (Onboarding): FYI — a few customers are in a paused state; i'll flag them in the CSV.
ops-bot: ticket CSMOPS-482 updated: status -> in_progress
Sam (Sales): couple of edge signals to consider later: contract amendments, third-party integrations status. not for the spike but flagging.
Ava (CS Ops): good call. capturing that as future improvements in the ticket. thanks all — will follow up with the Playbook YAML once I have the sample output. :sparkles:
